quest.title: The Great Tree: Statistical State
quest.description: Two people are arguing over something next to an enormous root system...

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: More data — that's what we need!

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: How can your devices function without data to support them?

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: So you suggest doing nothing till you get every single piece of data, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Will you analyze every incoming wave while trying to catch fish? No! You just need to focus on the one that comes with the fish!

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: Now I see why you never actually catch any fish.

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Come on! You've never studied at Hara{RUBY#[S]Semiotics}vatat yourself! So just cut it with the wordplay, okay? We should really get to work.

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: We can't afford more delays. Ours and Yasmin's theses might become obsolete if we take too long!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you arguing about?

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: You're...

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: You must be the Traveler Yasmin mentioned. You've really helped us a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: It's an honor to meet you, Traveler! An honor indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: My name is Pharez, and I study at Kshahrewar.

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: My name is Ladep, and I'm a student of Spantamad.

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Traveler, we could really use a favor from you.

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: You know that Yasmin has been sprinkling those potions around the Divine Tree's roots, right?

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Well... Um... The potions seem to have caused a little problem recently...

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Monsters of all kinds often appear at the potion-sprinkling sites.

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: I never changed anything about the formula or its proportions, I swear. As such, this must have been due to... Um, some unforeseen circumstances.

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Whatever you say... Anyway, Traveler, please come with us to check the sites where Yasmin sprinkled the potions.

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: There are probably lots of monsters, which precludes us from going there ourselves... We're going to need a companion with great martial prowess.

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: More importantly, even if the Fungi are not that dangerous, if the problem created by our potions reaches our tutor's ears...

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Our thesis proposals will be doomed for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: Especially here in Spantamad, where a single error in the submitted data will result in serious criticism...

choices.text: How have you dealt with similar conditions in the past?

response.speaker: Pharez
response.text: Well, hiring an adventurer is the usual solution. We've also turned to our tutor before, asking him to help find us some trustworthy Eremite members.

response.speaker: Pharez
response.text: But you know, a tutor's patience is not always infinite. Given the current circumstances, we're hesitant to trouble him again...

response.speaker: Ladep
response.text: So please, help us, Traveler! You're our only hope!

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: Look at that box. I think it's got the potions in it. Yasmin must have been here already.

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: Huh? The lids of the potions haven't been opened yet...

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Don't uncap them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wah! There are Fungi emerging behind you!

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: What? There weren't any before. What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's not listen to their nagging any longer, {NICKNAME}. Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: Whoo, lucky us, huh? Good thing the jar didn't break, or we might be experiencing some serious vomiting right now...

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Wait. You're not used to the smell? Didn't you make that yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: How many times have I explained to you that I added physiological emetics, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: It has nothing to do with whether you are used to it or not, the smell just triggers automatic vomiting in anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: Seriously, why do I even repeat myself? You won't understand anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: Also, where on earth did Yasmin go? She didn't even sprinkle the potions today...

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: She must have gone sampling some rare plants she found. Typical Amurta behavior and stuff... I mean, how do you still not know how they're like?

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: Alright, we'll look after this jar now. Thanks for your help, Traveler. Please take these.

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Ugh, these Amurta... They're just...

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough*... We should be fine here...

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Ugh... Blargh... You... This was your handiwork! How are you vomiting too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ugh... *cough* *cough* *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: I have... explained multiple times that I added physiological emetics!

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: It has nothing to do with whether you are used to it. The smell just triggers automatic vomiting in anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: Seriously, why do I even repeat myself? You won't understand anyway... Blergh...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Eh? Ladep, Pharez, and the Traveler, too? What brings all of you here?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: And the potion jar is broken... Was there some kind of monster attack?

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: Judging from how things look... That's probably the case. Did you see any monsters on your way here?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: No. In fact, I even took some time to sample several plants around here.

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: That's quite odd... Very odd indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: What's so odd about this? Your potion is what attracted them here, obviously!

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: What!? The field tests didn't demonstrate anything like that...

dialogues.speaker: Pharez
dialogues.text: Well, now you've seen it with your own eyes, can you be a little more realistic?

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: We will... discuss that later. Traveler, thanks so much for your help. Please take this as your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Ladep
dialogues.text: Where did it go wrong...
